target_group: Indian youth/candidates seeking fresh skilling, reskilling, upskilling or RPL
description: Central skill-development scheme supporting Short Term Training, Special Projects and Recognition of Prior Learning.
eligibility: Indian national with valid Aadhaar and job-role eligibility. Age: 15-45 for Short Term Training/Special Projects; 18-59 for RPL, with prior experience as required by the job role.

target_group: Eligible apprenticeship candidates and participating establishments
description: Promotes apprenticeship-based, on-the-job training through registered establishments.
benefit: apprenticeship training and stipend-related support under applicable rules
eligibility: Minimum age is generally 14 years; hazardous trades require 18 years. No universal upper age is specified under the Apprentices Act; trade-specific educational and physical requirements apply.

description: Credit-linked subsidy programme supporting new micro-enterprises in eligible manufacturing, service and permitted business activities.
eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. For projects above Rs.10 lakh in manufacturing and above Rs.5 lakh in business/service, at least 8th standard pass is required. Other PMEGP eligibility conditions apply.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
target_group: Poor rural youth, with social-inclusion focus including SC/ST beneficiaries
description: Placement-linked skill development programme for rural youth from poor households.
eligibility: Poor rural youth are generally 15-35 years old. The upper age limit is 45 for specified special groups including women and certain vulnerable categories, subject to programme eligibility rules.

scheme_name: PM SVANidhi (Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
description: Working-capital support scheme for eligible street vendors.
benefit: working-capital credit and related incentives under the scheme
eligibility: For eligible street vendors under PM SVANidhi rules. Do not treat ordinary kirana-store ownership alone as sufficient eligibility.

target_group: Micro-entrepreneurs and eligible small income-generating enterprises
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit for eligible micro-enterprises and allied activities.
benefit: credit up to Rs.20 lakh under applicable categories; Tarun Plus above Rs.10 lakh to Rs.20 lakh is for eligible borrowers who successfully repaid a previous Tarun loan
eligibility: Eligible income-generating micro-enterprises under PMMY lending rules. Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories apply, with Tarun Plus subject to prior successful Tarun repayment.
